verdict.rationale: Changelog entries confirm PlanetScale ships webhooks with named event types (backup.succeeded, backup.failed). They also show webhooks can carry a configurable Authorization header, so users can subscribe to platform events. The evidence is only two short changelog lines rather than dedicated docs. Missing for 10: a full webhook event catalog, setup/subscription docs (dashboard/API/CLI), payload signing and retry semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
